findings.summary: The six-duty self-gate is not wired into the engine default path. fleet_graph.dd.selfgate is imported by no production module; decision_deliver (decision_mcp.py), goal_line orchestration, and the scheduler never call decide() or SelfGateEvidence, so the spec's core behaviors '线自判路径成引擎默认', '自动履行六项取证义务', and '引擎侧机械履行 → 经 decision_deliver 投递' are not delivered. Only a standalone judging library plus its own unit tests were added, leaving the positive path (decided_by == dispatched_by, automatic self-judged APPROVE delivery) unreachable in the engine.

Spec item 5 (S7) — reconnecting the harvest reactor to fire after merge rather than at the gate — is not implemented. harvest_trigger / merge_then_harvest are pure, unreferenced functions, and the actual harvest reactor in supervise/harvest.py still triggers off EVENT_APPROVED_UNHARVESTED (passed gate), not the merge segment. No scheduler/harvest wiring change exists.
